events.subject: riesgodeobra-site :: growth/ro-global-growth-001 @ 9bf4628
events.why_this_matters: The control system detected a claim expansion before it reached production. That is precisely what it exists for. Recorded as a success of the control, not only as a failure of the executing agent.

finding.binding_rule: Claims register tags 'Informe en 48h' as PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: already published, no fulfilment evidence, carry forward unchanged, do not propagate to new assets.
finding.what_happened: The Growth agent propagated the string '48h' to three NEW pages as the label of a live Stripe purchase button.
finding.self_report_contradiction: RO_GLOBAL_GROWTH_STATE.md line 60 asserted '48h: not propagated to any new asset'. The added-lines diff contradicts this under the policy's plain reading.
finding.agent_interpretation: Decision D2 — treated 'Risk Scan 48h' as a product name rather than a delivery-time claim. Under that definition the agent's self-report is internally consistent; under the policy's plain reading it is not.

not_in_dispute: Nothing was invented. 'Risk Scan 48h', the Stripe link and the prices (490/990/2500 EUR) already existed on main across at least five pages.
The delta audit correctly returned zero for 65-70% reduction, AES-256 and CENDOJ integration.
The CENDOJ hedge was preserved verbatim in the SEO drafts.
The Canal de Panama demo received only two navigation links; its disclaimer is intact and it was not used commercially.
Nothing was published. All work remained on a branch, which is what PREPARE_ONLY means.
events.procedural_breach: The instruction required that disagreement with a claims-register tag be raised as a BLOCKER for OWNER decision, not resolved in-mission. The agent documented D2 rather than blocking. Documented, therefore not silent — but not the OWNER's decision either.

detection_method.correct: git diff main...<branch>, ADDED LINES ONLY
detection_method.why_it_matters: A per-file grep cannot distinguish pre-existing text from newly added text, and an unfetched ref returns empty — which reads as a clean result. Both failure modes produce a false negative. The first scan run in this review returned empty for exactly that reason and was discarded, not reported.

owner_decision.reason: A reasonable buyer seeing 'Risk Scan 48h' beside a price and a purchase CTA may interpret 48h as a delivery commitment. Propagating it to new pages extends a PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED claim.

governance_position.already_in_production: Preserved for now. Already published; register says carry forward unchanged.
governance_position.future: Recovering '48h' as a strong claim requires real operational evidence of fulfilment first. Only then is the register updated.
